title: Moonlit Breakwater: The Machinist's Harbor Charter
premise: In a drowned port exposed at the edge of the lunar tide, the machinist must rebalance a failing mechanical relay using a portable phase regulator.
ending: Recover the Harbor Charter and return with the stable field relay; Night Harbor Guild can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive undertow gate while evading the lighthouse revenant without sacrificing the stable field relay.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Night Harbor Guild to witness the portable phase regulator.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to divert power from a shelter
